ValidationRule.description: Created to ensure Card Expiry Month is populated when Recovery Type = Credit Card Refund
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Credit_Card_Refund_Required_Fields__c=TRUE, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Credit Card Refund'), ISPICKVAL(Card_Expiry_Month__c, '') ))
